## Release classification

Add exactly one label before merging:

- `breaking-change` — any incompatible change, even when it also adds a feature or fixes a bug
- `enhancement` — a compatible new feature or improvement
- `bugfix` — a compatible fix
- `other-change` — documentation, dependencies, or maintenance included in Other Changes
- `ignore-for-release` — omit this pull request from the changelog

Automated pull requests without a classification label are treated as Other Changes. If an automated pull request needs another classification or exclusion, add that one label.
